run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways n friends can pair up
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which solves the friends pairing problem using dynamic programming
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization or recursion instead of the iterative approach
review_f_gold: review the f_gold algorithm that computes pairing combinations with recurrence c = b + (i-1)*a
